 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

 About CircleCI 

 CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster.

Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold
Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital. 

 CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

 How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring 

 At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

 Where we may use AI 

 Job descriptions and messaging: AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.

 Application review: For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications.   

 Interview notes: With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected.

 Outreach: AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending.

 Our commitment 

 AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change.

 Your choices 

 You can ask for human-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact recruiting@circleci.com.   For how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering (Permanent/full-time)
jobs.location: Downtown Toronto (Toronto Dominion Centre / Design Exchange)
jobs.description:
CoreFactor is searching for a Director, Data Engineering on a permanent/full-time basis for a client in the GTA.  

 This position is hybrid and will require the successful incumbent to go into the office two (2) days per week.  

 As Director, Data Engineering within our clients Global Technology & Data Team, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping and executing the organization's enterprise data engineering strategy across a complex multi-cloud environment. Partnering closely with data leadership, enterprise architecture, and technology stakeholders, you will lead the design, delivery, and operation of scalable data platforms and services that enable business transformation, advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and data-driven decision making across North America and globally.  

 This is an opportunity to leverage your expertise to help drive the organizations' next-generation data ecosystem, modernize our enterprise data platforms, and position the organization for continued innovation and growth.  

 The Role: 

 Lead enterprise data engineering strategy: Direct and scale a high-performing team of managers and data engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.  

 Drive modern data platform delivery: Oversee the design, development, and implementation of enterprise-scale data platforms, including microservices architectures, data mesh and data fabric capabilities, AI/ML pipelines, Agentic AI and GenAI workflows, document extraction services, and business intelligence solutions.  

 Champion technology roadmap and innovation: Partner with Enterprise Architecture, product leaders, vendors, and technology stakeholders to define and execute the long-term data engineering roadmap, ensuring alignment with regional and global business objectives.  

 Establish operational excellence and DataOps practices: Define and enforce standards for DataOps, SDLC, CI/CD, data governance, security, documentation, code quality, and AI-enabled delivery methodologies to ensure scalable and reliable platform operations.  

 Ensure platform reliability and service excellence: Oversee the operational health, performance, and support of critical North American and global data products, driving incident management, platform availability, and adherence to enterprise service level agreements (SLAs).  

 Requirements
 Degree and/or diploma in: Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. Master’s degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.  

 8-10 years of progressive experience, preferably in: data engineering, data platform, cloud engineering, enterprise data architecture, or related technology leadership roles, including experience managing managers and technical professionals.  

 Proven experience in cloud-based data architecture and engineering: Deep expertise designing and scaling enterprise data platforms using Google Cloud Platform services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataproc, Cloud Data Fusion, Cloud Run, and Apigee.  

 Strong proficiency in modern engineering practices and tools: Experience with Kubernetes, particularly GKE, microservices architecture, enterprise APIs, serverless computing, infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD frameworks.  

 Strategic understanding of BI, analytics, and artificial intelligence: Knowledge of semantic data models, Looker, Power BI, machine learning pipelines, and AI-driven solutions that accelerate engineering delivery and operational excellence.  

 Exceptional leadership and communication skills: Ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional teams, translate technical strategy into measurable business outcomes, and build a strong culture of accountability and collaboration.  

 Commercial real estate industry experience: Considered an asset.

 Our client is seeking a dynamic and visionary leader to join our team as the Director of Business Analytics and Insights. In this pivotal role, you will drive strategic initiatives that enhance business performance and stakeholder engagement by combining strong business partnership, data-driven insights, and practical application of AI-enabled analytics. You will lead a talented analytics team to deliver impactful solutions, identify opportunities to automate and scale insight generation, and ensure analytics capabilities align with our company's goals and values. 

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 Team Leadership: Lead and manage a team of business analytics professionals to deliver high-quality insights and actionable recommendations to business stakeholders and partners. 

 Strategic leadership: Collaborate with business leaders and partners to understand priorities, challenges, and opportunities, using data to guide strategies that improve effectiveness, engagement, and outcomes. Develop and manage analytics strategies that provide actionable insights for key stakeholders, focusing on performance tracking, engagement, and growth opportunities. 

 Stakeholder Management: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders within the organization to ensure alignment and collaboration on business objectives. 

 Communication skills: Present findings, insights, and recommendations to senior leadership and other key stakeholders in a clear and compelling manner, translating complex data into actionable reports and strategic plans. 

 Performance Management: Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and relevant metrics to measure business performance, engagement, and operational activities. Continuously monitor, create dashboards, and report on these metrics, providing actionable insights to optimize outcomes. 

 D&A and AI Transformation: Drive the adoption of analytics, automation, and AI-enabled tools that enhance data accessibility, visualization, reporting, and decision support. Work closely with IT and D&A functions (i.e. data engineering, data governance, data operations) to ensure high data quality, appropriate controls, and compliance. 

 AI Enablement and Innovation: Identify, prioritize, and help implement AI use cases that improve business analytics, automate manual reporting, accelerate insight generation, and support more proactive decision-making across stakeholder groups and business partners. 

 Continuous Improvement: Continuously identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and innovation within the analytics function, including ways to use AI to reduce manual effort and improve speed, consistency, and quality of insights. 

 Technical Expertise: Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in business analytics, AI, automation, and data products. 

 AI Experimentation & Rapid Prototyping: Foster a culture of innovation by actively exploring emerging AI technologies, analytics tools, and automation capabilities. Roll up your sleeves to rapidly prototype, test, and validate new ideas, translating promising concepts into practical business solutions and scalable capabilities. 

 Platform & Solution Development: Partner with technical teams and, where appropriate, directly contribute to the development of analytics products, AI-enabled tools, web applications, and user-facing solutions that improve access to data, insights, and decision support. 

 Requirements
 7+ years of experience in business analytics and business intelligence within a B2B environment, ideally in financial services or asset management. 

 Technical degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field.  

 Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI), statistical software (e.g., Python), and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce); with a strong working knowledge and understanding of SQL. 

 Demonstrated curiosity and hands-on experience evaluating, prototyping, and applying emerging AI, automation, and productivity technologies to solve business problems and drive innovation. 

 Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and modern data architectures. 

 Exceptional leadership and people management abilities, with a focus on fostering a collaborative and results-driven team culture. 

 Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills 

 Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of conveying complex data and insights to executive teams, business leaders, and partners.

jobs.description:
Director, Software Engineering - CoCounsel Legal 

 Job Description 

 CoCounsel Legal is Thomson Reuters' AI assistant for legal professionals. This role leads the part of it that makes it adaptable: the agent's ability to take on a customer's skills, connect to third-party systems, and remember what matters to each legal team. 

 As Director, you will lead multiple engineering teams building the core of the CoCounsel Legal product. Your teams will let law firms and corporate legal departments add their own skills, connect their own tools through MCP integrations, and make CoCounsel work the way they do.  

 You will also contribute directly to the agent itself. This work carries high stakes for confidentiality, permissions, and customer control, and you will make the security and architecture decisions that earn customer trust. 
 We want an AI-native engineering leader who works at the forefront of AI-assisted development. You already build with coding agents and agent workflows, and you set the standard for how your teams do the same. You stay hands-on, make sound technical trade-offs, and plan strategically while the product and customer needs are still taking shape. 

 This is a hybrid role based in one of our hub locations: Minneapolis/Eagan, Dallas, Toronto, or New York City. Hybrid means two to three days a week in the office, depending on the role. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 Lead and develop multiple engineering teams, and build the leadership layer (managers and technical leads) as the scope grows. Own workforce planning, hiring, performance, calibration, and succession. 
 Own the engineering vision and delivery for how customers extend CoCounsel Legal. This includes custom skills and the tools to create, test, version, share, and retire them. 
 Lead the design and delivery of MCP and third-party integrations, so customers can connect their own systems and tools to the CoCounsel agent safely and at scale. 
 Contribute directly to the CoCounsel agent, working with Agent Core and Science on how it uses skills, tools, memory, and context. 
 Own agent memory at the user and organization levels. Start narrow, prove each step with evidence, and expand. 
 Make customization safe for the enterprise. Own the security model for sharing and integrations, including least-privilege permissions, audit logging, and administrator controls. Lead the response to complex security and privacy issues, working with Security and Privacy. 
 Make evaluation a release gate. Work with Science and subject-matter experts so that skills and agent behavior are tested for quality, accuracy, and fidelity to customer instructions before they ship. 
 Set the technical direction. Decide what to build, buy, or partner on, favor reusable primitives over one-off features, and make clear trade-offs among speed, quality, security, and cost. 
 Set the standard for AI-native engineering. Define how your teams use coding agents and AI tools to build, review, and verify work, and model that practice yourself. 
 Stay hands-on. Spend at least 30% of your time on technical work such as design and code review, prototyping, and building with AI coding agents. 
 Build a culture of end-to-end ownership. Your teams design, build, deploy, and operate their services, including on-call, SLOs, and incident response. You take part in the escalation path for major incidents. 
 Measure outcomes, not activity. Use DORA metrics alongside quality and developer-experience measures, and fund the next stage of work through short, evidence-based checkpoints. 
 Own the investment envelope across people, cloud, AI inference, and vendor services. 
 Work directly with customers and Product, including beta customers. Explain engineering trade-offs clearly to business and executive stakeholders. 
 Partner with peers in Agent Core, Application Experience, Platform, and Corporate Integrations to keep CoCounsel coherent as a product. 

 Required Qualifications 

 10+ years of software engineering experience, including proven success leading multiple teams and leading through other managers or technical leads 
 Hands-on engineering work within the last two to three years, and the ability to contribute to design, code, and architecture 
 Hands-on experience building agentic systems or LLM-based agent features, such as tool use, prompt and instruction management, memory, retrieval, or context management, and a practical sense of where they fail 
 AI-native ways of working: daily, proficient use of AI coding tools and agent setups to do engineering work, and experience setting team norms for verifying agent-generated work 
 Experience building integrations with third-party systems, and experience with MCP or comparable tool and plugin protocols 
 Experience building platforms that customers configure and extend, such as skills, plugins, extension frameworks, or workflow and automation features 
 Strong backend foundation, including API design, authentication and authorization, multi-tenancy, versioning, data lifecycle, event-driven processing, and observability 
 Experience making sound technical trade-offs and resolving complex security issues, particularly where third-party access and customer data are involved 
 Experience evaluating agentic systems and building evaluation into the release process, working with science and subject-matter experts 
 Experience leading teams that operate what they build, with production on-call, SLOs, and incident response 
 Proven strategic planning: setting direction under ambiguity and re-planning based on evidence from working software and customers 
 Accountability for workforce planning, budget, and build-versus-buy decisions 
 Proficiency in Python and strong engineering fundamentals, including cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), CI/CD, and testing strategy 
 Understanding of the privacy, security, and compliance obligations of handling confidential and privileged customer data 
 Clear, persuasive communication with engineers, product partners, and senior business stakeholders 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience building agent memory, such as user and organization memory, memory search and inspection, and giving users and administrators control over what is kept 
 Experience building tools that let non-engineers create and improve agent behavior, such as skill or prompt authoring, test chats, and review workflows with versioning and rollback 
 Background in legal technology, or in enterprise software for legal, compliance, or risk functions, including customers who need confidentiality, ethical walls, and audit trails 
 Experience with enterprise administration and sharing models, such as groups, roles, org-level publishing, and usage reporting 
 Experience running customer beta programs and turning feedback into a path to general availability 
 Experience building a new product line alongside an established one, and organizing teams around shared platforms 
 Contributions to open-source agent, MCP, or developer-tooling projects

jobs.description:
Job Description 
 Thomson Reuters Labs is the global research and development division of Thomson Reuters. We bring together scientists, engineers, and domain experts to explore emerging technologies and develop state-of-the-art AI products, bridging frontier science with practical application. Labs builds and ships custom models for professional workflows requiring fiduciary-grade AI. The Thomson LLM model family was developed by training leading open-weight models on decades of authoritative Thomson Reuters content, with thousands of hours of subject-matter-expert input. Owning the model layer is how we earn trust in the most regulated, highest-stakes professional workflows. 

 Mariner, Thomson Reuters' custom inference platform, serves every production call to the Thomson model family and is scaling to new product integrations and business lines. This Director, Model Inference Engineering role leads and grows the team that owns the platform, working with senior technical leadership and a cross-functional team to ensure production footing, cost-tracking, compliance, and capacity planning as we scale. You'll lead the inference-engineering team and partner closely with research and product stakeholders, so the serving stack keeps pace with new model releases and product expansion. 

 For more on the latest model release, see the Thomson 1.0 Technical Report on Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/spaces/tri-fair-lab/publications/blob/main/Thomson_1_0_Technical_Report.pdf 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Grow the inference-engineering team: set the hiring bar, run performance and growth conversations, retain in a competitive market, and build an effective and sustainable operating rhythm (on-call, incident reviews, onboarding) as the system expands internationally. 
 Own delivery of Mariner's engineering roadmap: work with technical leadership, engineers, and researchers to plan and resource against objectives and key results, driving product integrations and international deployment while balancing cost/latency targets. 
 Scale Thomson's production footing: drive the ISO 27001 compliance path, deliver clean cost-tracking and attribution for Finance, and run GPU-capacity contingency planning so a capacity change doesn't force downtime or costly parallel running. 
 Represent inference-engineering tradeoffs (cost vs. latency vs. reliability) to senior leadership and cross-functional partners. 
 Ensure token-economics benchmarks are produced and published, showing Thomson's cost advantage over closed-model APIs when the numbers support it. 

 Required Qualifications 
 Production ML-serving depth. You've led or managed inference infrastructure for large models at real production traffic and scale, not just in a research or prototype setting, with wins delivered by teams you led that you can point to, and the fluency to hire, coach, and defend the work.  
 Infrastructure and cost ownership. You've owned a cost-attribution or compliance program end to end (control design, evidence collection, external audit such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or comparable) for a production system on Kubernetes or similar. 
 Track record building and leading a focused engineering team, ideally growing a team from a handful of engineers rather than inheriting one at scale. 
 Experience balancing resource constraints. GPU capacity, region availability, and cost are active, managed constraints in this role, not abstractions. 
 Experience supporting external-facing or customer-facing deployments, not only internal research infrastructure. 
 Operational excellence in engineering teams and systems. 

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with common LLM-serving stacks (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton, SGLang, or similar). 
 Experience working with research and product stakeholders to define the engineering roadmap of a production system. 
 Exposure to GPU-cluster capacity planning or multi-region/multi-cloud deployment. 
 Familiarity with systems development languages (Rust, Go, etc.). 
 Exposure to a regulated or compliance-heavy production environment. 

 Even if you don't have all of the above requirements, we encourage you to apply to explore a mutual fit!

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Director, Product Management to shape the future of the Agentic Platform for Tax and Trade, one of Thomson Reuters’ most strategically important AI-first product portfolios, spanning ONESOURCE and our Transactional Compliance, Tax and Trade products.

 Join the Transactional Compliance Product team as we build the next generation of AI-first, agentic experiences for tax, trade, and compliance professionals. We are looking for a curious, commercially astute, and technically fluent product leader who thrives on turning complex customer problems, market opportunities, and technology shifts into elegant, scalable, and commercially successful solutions.

 Job Description 
 In this pivotal leadership role, you will own the Agentic Platform for the Tax and Trade portfolio: the shared foundation that product teams across ONESOURCE use to build, orchestrate, govern, and scale AI agents. You will define the platform’s product vision and strategy, set its roadmap and standards, and deliver the shared capabilities that let our product lines move faster and more safely in the agentic era, in service of our vision to meet customers at the intersection of commerce and compliance.

 You will partner closely with Product-line VP's, treating each product line as a primary customer of the platform, and aligning on priorities, dependencies, and shared investments across the portfolio. You will also partner with Engineering, TR Labs, Data, Security, Compliance, Design, Product Marketing, Sales, and Commercial teams.

 This role requires a proven product leader with a track record of delivering AI, agentic, automation, workflow, or platform products at scale in B2B SaaS. You will bring strong commercial judgment, deep customer orientation, and technical credibility with engineering and AI/ML teams, along with the ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across a matrixed global organization.

 Scope 
 You will report to the Head of Product Management for Tax and Trade and sit on the product line leadership team.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Platform Vision & Strategy
 Define and evangelize a long-term vision and strategy for the Agentic Platform, aligned with Thomson Reuters’ broader AI, product, and business strategy.
 Own the platform roadmap, covering orchestration, agent memory, tool and integration frameworks (including MCP), identity and permissions, and governance, balancing near-term product line needs with long-term differentiation.
 Establish clear plans for functional and agentic AI across a broad ecosystem of technologies and partners.
 Sponsor market research, competitive analysis, and customer discovery to identify unmet needs and opportunities for differentiation.

 Cross-Portfolio Alignment & Delivery
 Establish a single platform roadmap and dependency model, with shared priorities that balance platform investment against each product line’s commitments.
 Partner with product-line VPs to understand their needs, set shared priorities, and resolve trade-offs, working to align interests and implement scalable solutions.
 Treat the platform as a product: define the developer experience, APIs, and service levels for product teams building agents on it.
 Establish agent evaluation and quality standards (accuracy, explainability, safety, and regression testing) that product teams adopt as release gates.
 Own unit economics for agentic workloads, including token consumption, cost to serve, and consumption-based pricing and packaging, in partnership with product-line VPs and Finance.
 Establish governance and human-in-the-loop controls for regulated tax, trade, and compliance workflows, ensuring experiences are trusted, explainable, secure, and reliable.
 Define success metrics covering platform adoption, reliability, developer satisfaction, cost efficiency, and business impact, and use them to guide investment decisions.

 Leadership & Influence
 Build, lead, and mentor the platform product management team, fostering accountability, customer obsession, and commercial discipline.
 Socialize and align senior stakeholders to platform strategy and roadmap, and evangelize the vision across the organization.
 Be a recognized thought leader inside and outside the organization, writing, blogging, and speaking at events on agentic platforms and AI in tax, trade, and compliance.

 Required Qualifications 
 Curious and innovative, with an obsession for customers’ problems and needs, and a drive to solve them in unique ways.
 Agile, with a strong sense of urgency and comfort leading in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. You are unafraid of failure and learn quickly from setbacks.
 An effective communicator who projects confidence and communicates concisely and clearly to executives, peers, customers, and partners.
 Experience: 10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role managing platform, multiple product lines, or teams in B2B SaaS, workflow, data, AI, or enterprise software.
 Working fluency with agent tooling and protocols such as MCP, model evaluation, data quality, and LLM cost drivers, along with responsible AI considerations.
 Hands-on, daily user of frontier AI tools, with a current, practical understanding of what agentic systems can and cannot do, and comfortable prototyping with agentic tools.
 Strong commercial acumen, with a track record of driving measurable outcomes through monetization, packaging, pricing, adoption, and retention.
 Experience in cross-functional, matrixed environments with multiple product lines, and familiarity with enterprise business systems, ERPs, and surrounding ecosystems.
 Proven high-energy, highly collaborative leadership approach, with experience building high-performing product teams.

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience shipping agentic or AI platform capabilities such as orchestration, tool use, memory, or evaluation infrastructure (strongly preferred).
 Experience with internal developer platforms, APIs, or ecosystems where other teams build on your product (strongly preferred).
 Experience creating tax and accounting, global trade, or similar highly regulated and complex SaaS products (strongly preferred).
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

jobs.description:
Director, Engineering, AI 
 Job Description 
 Are you passionate about transforming how legal professionals find trusted answers with AI? Join our Global Westlaw Engineering organization and help shape the future of AI-driven legal research. 

 Westlaw helps legal professionals around the world research, analyze, and act with confidence. We are building the next generation of fiduciary-level, AI-powered legal research and workflow capabilities, and we are changing how we build software. 

 As Director, you will lead a global organization of engineering managers, senior engineers, and vendor partners. You will own the multi-year AI engineering strategy and its alignment with the product delivery roadmap. You will move the organization to mission-based teams with clear ownership and accountability. You will also drive the shift to AI-assisted, agent-driven development and use engineering data to guide decisions and show results. 

 We want a technical leader with a track record of leading AI transformation, who leads by example, stays hands-on, keeps up with AI and engineering best practices, uses data to find what needs to change, and empowers teams to innovate across the organization.

 Key Responsibilities: 
 Lead
 Lead a high-performing global organization. Set clear expectations, coach managers and engineers, and lead by example, using AI tools and engineering data in your own work. 
 Stay close to the technical work. Work directly with senior engineers on architecture, technical direction, and hard problems to raise the technical bar across the organization. 
 Own Engineering strategy implementation and its alignment with the product delivery roadmap. Run it as a living plan with clear milestones and owners, adapt quickly as priorities evolve, and recommend measures that keep engineering objectives aligned to business strategy. 
 Lead the transformation to a mission-based operating model. Replace project-by-project handoffs with long-lived teams that own a product area, service, or customer outcome from design through production support. Define each team's mission, scope, decision rights, and the skills and authority it needs. 
 Set measures for each mission. Define measures such as reliability, quality, delivery speed, adoption, and cost. Review them regularly and use them to guide priorities, resourcing, and accountability. 
 Manage the vendor relationship. Help the vendor keep pace with business needs. Integrate vendor-managed teams into the organization, with clear scope, outcomes, service levels, and governance. Hold them to the same standards as internal teams for architecture, quality, security, and delivery, and measure their performance with the same data. Make sure they document their work and transfer knowledge, so the organization does not depend on a single vendor. 
 Decide what to do in-house, with partners, or through vendors. Balance cost, speed, capability, risk, and long-term knowledge retention. 
 Communicate proactively. Show how your organization's work delivers business value and supports strategy, and work directly with stakeholders and peers to shape the future of our products. 
 Deliver
 Deliver strategic projects with urgency. Partner with Product Management, UX Design, and other Technology teams. Remove blockers, make timely decisions, and enable your teams to solve complex business problems with clearly defined outcomes. 
 Drive the end-to-end AI lifecycle. Own the work from retrieval and model integration through evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. 
 Set the standard for operational excellence. Hold AI and non-AI services to high standards for reliability, security, performance, and cost. Champion a DevOps-first model supported by automation, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code on AWS. 
 Manage the project portfolio. Own budget, priorities, and staff allocation. 
 Operate: Run a Data-Driven, AI-Enabled Organization:
 Provide guardrails and empower teams to use AI. Equip managers, engineers, and teams to apply AI in daily engineering work, including coding assistants, agents, code review, test automation, and quality evaluation. Provide clear guardrails for responsible use, covering security, data handling, and human review of AI-generated code and outputs. Within those guardrails, encourage teams to experiment and adopt AI, and remove the barriers that slow them down. 
 Make decisions with data. Analyze GitHub data, such as pull request cycle time, review latency, build and deployment frequency, and AI tool usage, to find bottlenecks and show where change is working. 
 Track ownership and accountability. Use incident response, change failure rate, and cycle time by team to show whether ownership and accountability are improving. Share results openly, use them to coach rather than blame, and turn them into practical changes in how teams work. 
 Measure the impact of AI. Track its effect on delivery speed, code quality, defect rates, and reliability. Use those measures to adjust strategy and investment. 
 Own the economics of AI usage. Set AI budgets, and track and optimize token consumption, inference cost, and tooling spend. Guide model selection and cost-versus-quality trade-offs, balancing them against productivity, quality, and speed. 
 Innovate
 Stay on top of the AI landscape. Follow new models, agent frameworks, tool protocols such as MCP, and retrieval patterns. Judge what is production-ready, bring it into your teams' practices, and grow adoption of AI/ML engineering practices and frameworks across the enterprise. 
 Try new approaches. Take informed risks. Encourage your managers and teams to do the same, and recognize those who do. 
 Required Qualifications 
 Education. A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 Experience. 10+ years in software development, including 3+ years leading AI solution development, and 10+ years managing managers and building high-performing engineering teams in an agile environment. 
 Organizational leadership. Experience leading managers, individual contributors, and vendor-managed teams, including scope, performance, cost, and quality. You can coach managers on people leadership and engage credibly with Staff and Principal engineers. 
 Strategy and execution. Experience turning a multi-year vision into programs, roadmaps, and measurable results across multiple teams, including large-scale rollouts and infrastructure initiatives. 
 Shipping AI in production. A track record of shipping LLM-based applications, RAG, or agent workflows in production-grade software. You can speak credibly about prompt and context design, retrieval, evaluation, and production trade-offs. 
 Cloud, DevOps, and reliability. Strong depth in cloud-native architecture on AWS, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code, and experience running mission-critical, high-availability systems. 
 Hands-on AI tool use. Daily use of AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code). You lead by example and have empowered managers and teams to adopt AI-assisted development, with strong practices for review, quality, and security. 
 Data-driven leadership and AI economics. Experience defining and analyzing metrics such as DORA, cycle time, quality, and adoption to find problems and show results. Working knowledge of token usage, inference and tooling costs, and how to measure the return on AI investment. 
 Leading change. Experience shifting team mindsets, introducing new tools and ways of working, and moving teams to mission-based, outcome-owned models with clear ownership, decision rights, and accountability. 
 Communication. Excellent communication skills. You can explain complex technical and financial trade-offs to executives and customers and align stakeholders. 

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience leading globally distributed teams and restructuring an engineering organization around products, services, or customer outcomes. 
 Agentic systems and responsible AI. Experience shipping agentic systems in production, including evaluation, benchmarking, and monitoring, and knowledge of AI guardrails and governance. 
 LLM APIs, search, and agent frameworks. Experience with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) at scale, information retrieval or search systems, and standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). 
 Vendor and cost management. Experience with vendor selection, contract negotiation, and transitions between vendor and in-house teams. Experience managing cloud and AI cost through FinOps or inference cost optimization. 
 Career paths. Experience building career paths for both management and technical (IC) tracks, and retaining senior technical talent. 
 Technical background. Strong Python and RESTful API design skills. AWS certifications, such as Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer, are a plus. 
 Domain background. Background in legal or other regulated, content-rich professional domains.

jobs.description:
Director, Product Portfolio Management 

 Job Description: 
 The Portfolio Management team makes sure our product investments and resources go to the most strategic, highest-priority opportunities. Working across the product organization, the team partners with product leaders and informs enterprise investment decisions.

 As Director, Product Portfolio Management, you'll bring an objective, portfolio-wide perspective to how we plan, fund, and rationalize our products. You'll partner across Product Management, Product Operations, Product Engineering, Finance, and Strategy to run the core processes that connect strategy to investment decisions and financial outcomes, moving comfortably between the detail of a single business case and the big picture of the entire portfolio.

 AI is central to how this team works: the large majority of our analysis and decision-making is AI-assisted, and we expect this role to push that further.

 Key Responsibilities: 
 Lead the annual capital planning cycle - Own the end-to-end process for prioritizing product investment, from creation and evolution of guidance and template materials to running and owning the kick-off sessions through ongoing stakeholder reviews and funding decisions and managing in-year funding requests as they arise.
 Drive product profitability and rationalization - Working closely with the Corporate Finance team you will be responsible for analyzing product performance and profitability supporting Portfolio Management recommendations on coverage levels, product sunsets, and the divestiture pipeline across the portfolio.
 Own the master product list and portfolio taxonomy - Maintain a consistent, standardized view of the portfolio, keeping it accurate and connected to reporting and the systems that depend on it and ensuring all stakeholders are kept informed of changes as they happen.
 Track business cases and investment decisions - Keep visibility over business cases throughout the investment and delivery lifecycle, ensuring decisions are well-informed, documented, and followed through.
 Put AI at the center of the work - Use AI tools to accelerate analysis, synthesis, and decision support across capital planning, profitability, business case tracking and portfolio reporting and continually raise the bar for how the team applies AI.
 Partner closely with Finance - Work hand in hand with Finance on capital allocation, profitability, and the numbers behind portfolio decisions, keeping investment choices grounded in facts.
 Support resource and people planning - Provide insights to help direct resources to the highest-priority products, so agreed strategies and plans get executed across the portfolio.
 Distill the portfolio story for leadership and investors - Evaluate product roadmaps and turn complex product and financial information into clear insight that informs decisions and supports investor relations.
 Align stakeholders across the organization - Bring alignment across Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Strategy, influencing at all levels to make portfolio trade-offs and see them through.

 Required Qualifications: 
 8+ years of experience in portfolio management, product management, product strategy, or product operations, ideally within a product, technology, or software organization.
 A strong track record of managing processes and building relationships with cross-functional partners.
 Outstanding organizational and communication skills, including the synthesis and simplification of complex ideas.
 A bachelor's degree or equivalent; MBA preferred, particularly one that brings strong financial and commercial grounding.
 Skills and behaviors
 Understanding how product, engineering, and design work together, enough to put portfolio and investment decisions in the right context.
 A solid grasp of the Thomson Reuters product portfolio, product strategy and the markets we serve: legal, tax, corporates, and risk & fraud, and the dynamics that shape them.
 Financial acumen, comfortable analyzing profitability and business cases, including ROI, IRR, and NPV, to inform investment trade-offs.
 Fluency with and enthusiasm for AI tools, you actively use AI to accelerate analysis, synthesis, and decision-making.
 Outstanding communication and a collaboration mindset, you synthesize and simplify complex ideas and engage with all stakeholders to support clear and timely communication to senior leadership.
 A strong execution orientation, you lead cross-functional teams and external partners to timely decisions and follow through.
 Critical thinking and sound judgment, you make smart trade-offs and are comfortable challenging assumptions and asking the provocative questions.
 Comfort with ambiguity, you adapt nimbly and help others navigate complex situations.
 Data-driven, you seek out and analyze data, with strong attention to detail and comfort using analytics and BI tools.

 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Product management experience; familiarity with the software development lifecycle and how product teams operate is a plus.
 Hands-on financial modeling (building or stress-testing investment and profitability models) is a plus.

jobs.description:
Director of Product — SafeSend (Gather & Deliver) 

 Job Description: 
 Accounting firms are reinventing how they prepare tax returns, and their clients, taxpayers expect a simple, secure, digital way to hand over documents and get a finished return. Firms expect everything in between to be faster, more automated, and connected to the tools they already run. SafeSend is where that happens: the taxpayer-facing perimeter and engine of Tax Workflow for accounting firm clients, the surface taxpayers touch, and, through its APIs, the engine firms build their own workflows on.

 As Director of Product for SafeSend, you will own that surface and lead its evolution into an AI-driven, agentic gather-prepare-deliver experience on Thomson Reuters’ CoCounsel platform and open it up so firms and partners can build on it.

 The opportunity: 
 Firms are consolidating fragmented point tools into one connected workflow and want a single partner to deliver it.
 Taxpayers expect a modern, mobile, trustworthy way to share documents and receive their return.
 Document data extraction is going AI-native; firms want agentic preparation and review and are adopting it now.
 Firms increasingly want to build on open APIs so their own portals, data and reporting stay connected as the market converges.
 SafeSend sits at the center of all four. This is a build-and-converge mandate — shaping a market-defining product, not maintaining a mature one.

 Key Responsibilities: 
 Deliver SafeSend.  Own the SafeSend portfolio end to end — Gather, Organizers, e-Sign, Delivery, Returns and Extensions — season over season, at the reliability and scale that tax-filing peaks demand.
 Converge SafeSend and TaxCaddy.  Bring the best of SafeSend and TaxCaddy together into one Gather & Deliver experience for every firm and taxpayer
 Componentize the portfolio.  Turn each part of SafeSend into reusable workflow components that can be recomposed across the gather – prepare – deliver flow and used across the broader CoCounsel platform, rather than locked inside a single app.
 Enable expanded SafeSend access via APIs and orchestration.  Expand the SafeSend API surface — open APIs, events and integrations — as a first-class capability, so firms and partners embed SafeSend in their own portals and workflows and keep their tools, data and reporting connected, with orchestration so AI agents and partner systems can coordinate gather and delivery programmatically.
 Deliver agentic Gather & Deliver through CoCounsel.  Bring agentic Gather — and AI-driven extraction, preparation and review — into the SafeSend experience on the CoCounsel platform, so more of the work shifts from staff to the platform while the firm stays in control.

 What success looks like: 
 Firms experience one connected Gather & Deliver workflow, whatever ecosystem they run today.
 The SafeSend API is something firms and partners actively build on, not a bespoke integration project.
 Firms reach AI-driven, agentic preparation and review through SafeSend, season over season.
 Taxpayers get a simpler, faster, more trustworthy experience — and firms see measurably less manual work.

 Required Qualifications: 
 8+ years in product management, including leading a product line at scale as a Director or senior PM.
 Experience building and productizing platform, API or developer-facing products — not only features on top of them.
 A track record of converging or migrating products without disrupting existing customers.
 Fluency with AI-native products (data extraction, agents, orchestration) and comfort partnering with a platform team.
 Strong systems thinking — able to see a portfolio as composable components rather than a monolith.
 Experience in the tax & accounting workflow space strongly preferred
 Strong stakeholder management and a proven record of building high-performing teams

 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Background in tax & accounting, fintech, or document / data-processing workflows.
 Experience partnering with large, demanding enterprise customers as design partners.
 Comfort owning commercially consequential product decisions.
 Advanced business or technical degree preferred

jobs.description:
Build the commercial engine that powers profitable growth. 
Reporting to the Chief Commercial Officer, the Vice-President, Revenue Operations & Commercial Excellence is a transformational executive leader responsible for building the capabilities, insights, governance and operating disciplines that enable predictable, profitable growth across the organization. As a key strategic partner to the executive team, you will connect commercial strategy, planning, pricing, analytics, technology and execution across the customer lifecycle, creating a unified view of performance that enables smarter decisions and stronger business outcomes across North America. 
This role is ideal for a strategic and commercially minded leader who excels at translating complexity into action. You bring a balance of analytical rigor, operational excellence and change leadership, along with the ability to influence across functions, build high-performing teams and drive enterprise-wide alignment. jobs.description:
About Leo Berwick 
 Leo Berwick is an innovative mergers and acquisitions consulting firm. We are composed of experienced advisors from global law and accounting firms who add value to transactions as trusted partners throughout the deal life cycle. At Leo Berwick, we hire the best and the brightest. Our teams deliver a dedicated and customized service to every client. 

 Within Leo Berwick, our technology, data, and AI team works with infrastructure and private equity clients, and private market investors and their portfolio companies, across the full deal lifecycle, from M&A services to AI strategy and execution. We believe technology can have an outsized impact on firm performance and enterprise value. 

 As a growth-stage firm, we move quickly, work collaboratively, and value people who take initiative and thrive in a fast-paced environment. Our culture is grounded in high performance, continuous learning, and the shared ambition to build something exceptional, together. About the Role: 
 Leo Berwick is hiring a Senior Leader (Managing Director or Partner) to build and scale our power, utilities, and renewables practice, one of our core sectors. This is a senior, client-facing leadership role for someone with deep industry expertise in power, utilities, or renewables, paired with technology and/or data depth. You will lead technology diligence and data and AI value creation initiatives for PE sponsors and infrastructure funds investing in the energy and infrastructure space. 

 We’re looking for someone with 10–15+ years of experience, built at a technology consultancy, a boutique advisory firm, or as an operator in industry. You should be ready to build and sell a practice, not just deliver within one. Experience in technology consulting and M&A is an asset, but sector credibility and technical depth come first. 

 In this leadership role, you will have defined responsibilities and a focus area, and you will also be part of the leadership team, exposed to all aspects of building and growing the business and contributing well beyond your own practice. 

 Why Join Us: 
 The opportunity to help build and shape our technology, data and AI - power, utilities and renewables practice from the ground up 
 Equity participation aligned to the value you create 
 Direct access to leadership and accelerated career growth 
 Competitive compensation (base + performance bonus) and comprehensive benefits 
 Flexible, remote-first work model across North America 
 Significant breadth of experience: work across deal stages and problem types with C-suite portfolio company leaders and PE sponsors focused on infrastructure and the energy transition 

 What you'll do 
 Practice Leadership & Growth 
 Sector Practice Building: Lead the build-out of Leo Berwick’s power, utilities and renewables technology advisory practice, defining our point of view, offerings, and go-to-market approach for the sector. 
 Business Development: Originate and close new engagements with PE sponsors, infrastructure funds, and corporate acquirers active in power, utilities, and renewables. Bring the capability to build a book of business, recognizing any portable relationships remain subject to prior firm non-compete and non-solicit obligations. 
 Internal Enablement: Train and mentor staff on how to run technology diligence in the sector — the operational, regulatory, and technology nuances specific to power and utilities that don’t show up in a generalist diligence approach. 

 Full-Lifecycle Deal Advisory 
 Diligence & Risk Assessment: Lead buy-side and sell-side technology diligence workstreams to evaluate target technology environments, architecture, and organizational readiness ahead of a transaction. 
 Carve-Out & Separation: Own technology separation planning and execution for carve-out transactions, including TSA scope definition, stranded cost management, and TSA exit strategy. 
 Integration: Lead post-merger technology integration planning and execution, ensuring synergy realization and business continuity through Day 1 and beyond. 

 Client & Stakeholder Management 
 Executive Relationships: Serve as the primary technology advisor to portfolio company C-suite executives (CIO, CTO, CDO) and PE deal teams throughout the transaction lifecycle. 
 Engagement Leadership: Own engagement delivery end-to-end, managing cross-functional teams and ensuring quality, timeliness, and client satisfaction. 

 Firm Leadership & Collaboration 
 Leadership Breadth: As part of the leadership team, contribute to all aspects of building and growing the business, and collaborate across practices and service lines (including data, AI and cyber engagements beyond your sector focus) as your expertise allows. 

 What We're Looking For: 
 In order of priority: 
 1. Sector Depth 
 Power, Utilities & Renewables Expertise: Direct, hands-on experience serving clients in renewables, power generation, or utilities — not adjacent sectors like oil & gas or industrial products, and not corporate functions (e.g., finance) within a utility. This is the most important qualification for this role.

 Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated ability to originate and grow business, not solely execute within an existing book of work. 
 Team & Client Leadership: Experience leading cross-functional, often distributed teams, and building trust with senior executives and investment professionals.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Business Intelligence and Analytics
jobs.description:
The Senior Director, Business Intelligence and Analytics is a senior enterprise leader responsible for building and leading GS1 Canada’s business intelligence, analytics, and market insight capability. The role gives the organization a clear, trusted, and evidence-based view of strategic performance, subscriber growth and retention, product and service adoption, sector opportunity, and emerging market dynamics.

 The role leads a team of analysts and market intelligence professionals who measure organizational performance, identify growth opportunities, assess subscriber and sector trends, and translate data into clear recommendations for senior leadership. The function will move beyond traditional reporting toward predictive, decision-oriented analytics that explain what is happening, why it matters, what is likely to happen next, and where action is required.

 A central mandate is to transform the analytics function through the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence. This leader will establish the roadmap, operating model, capabilities, and governance needed to embed AI into analytical workflows; improve the speed, quality, and reach of insight; and equip the team and business leaders to use AI effectively and responsibly.

The role translates GS1 Canada’s enterprise strategy into measurable outcomes, owns the enterprise KPI and performance framework, and ensures executives and business leaders receive timely, consistent, and decision-ready insight. It partners closely with Product, Subscriber Management, Finance, Marketing, Industry Relations, Community Engagement, Technology, Operations, Data Governance, Privacy, Cybersecurity, and the AI Council.

 This is a high-impact, enterprise-facing leadership role requiring analytical judgment, strategic thinking, executive communication, change leadership, people development, and 
 Key Responsibilities
 Build and Lead the Business Intelligence and Analytics Function 
 Build, lead, and mature GS1 Canada’s business intelligence and analytics capability, including enterprise reporting, subscriber and sector analytics, product and service usage analytics, market intelligence, and growth insights.
 Establish a trusted and consistent single version of the truth by aligning data definitions, metrics, dashboards, and reports across business units
 Lead enterprise dashboards, executive scorecards, and recurring insight products covering subscriber growth, retention, churn, adoption, engagement, service usage, sector penetration, revenue performance, and strategic execution.
 Advance the function from descriptive reporting to diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive insight that identifies drivers, anticipates risks and opportunities, and recommends action.
 Establish standards for analytical quality, metric definitions, dashboard governance, documentation, reproducibility, and executive communication.
 Partner with Technology, Data Governance, and business teams to improve data accessibility, quality, reliability, and fitness for analytical and AI use.
 Lead Subscriber, Sector and Market Intelligence 
 Build an integrated intelligence capability that combines subscriber and operational data, sector insight, competitive intelligence, and external market trends.
 Monitor changes in subscriber expectations, digital and agentic commerce, product data management, regulation, sustainability, 2D barcode adoption, AI-enabled data management, and other developments affecting GS1 Canada’s relevance and growth.
 Synthesize quantitative and qualitative signals from sector boards, working groups, subscriber interactions, support channels, research, and industry forums in partnership with relevant business teams.
 Identify enterprise-wide patterns and sector-specific needs, and provide regular executive briefings on market shifts, subscriber expectations, competitors, opportunities, and strategic risks.
 Recommend where insights indicate a need to adjust strategic focus, product priorities, positioning, education, or market engagement.
 Own the Enterprise KPI and Measurement Framework 
 Define and maintain the enterprise KPI framework, aligned to strategy, subscriber value, growth, adoption, financial performance, and operational outcomes.
 Set consistent definitions and ownership for core measures, including subscriber growth, retention, churn, engagement, adoption, product and service usage, sector penetration, revenue trends, and strategic progress
 Partner with Finance and functional leaders to ensure measures are reliable, decision-useful, and consistently applied across executive, functional, and sector reporting.
 Identify gaps or inconsistencies in measurement and recommend improvements to data, instrumentation, reporting, and accountability.
 Focus leadership attention on the few measures that matter most, connecting activity to subscriber outcomes, growth impact, and strategic value.
 Lead the AI-Enabled Transformation of Analytics 
 Develop and execute a multi-year roadmap to transform the analytics function through AI, aligned with enterprise strategy, the AI Council, and GS1 Canada’s technology and data priorities.
 Prioritize high-value use cases such as automated data preparation and reporting, insight synthesis, anomaly detection, forecasting, segmentation, churn and propensity analysis, and conversational or self-service analytics.
 Redesign analyst workflows and roles to combine automation with human judgment, enabling the team to spend less time producing reports and more time interpreting results, advising leaders, and driving action.
 Establish a disciplined path from experimentation to production, including use-case intake, value assessment, pilots, validation, adoption planning, controls, and scaling.

jobs.title: Account Director, Influencer Marketing
jobs.description:
At Viral Nation, we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world’s fastest-growing digital brands. Viral Nation offers a fluid, creative, and growth-oriented environment that will support your ambitions to apply your talents in an open, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We’re driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we’re just getting started. 

 While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar! 

 Viral Nation is seeking a dedicated Account Director with a robust mix of influencer marketing, social media, analytics, content marketing experience. As an Account Director, you are instrumental and accountable for driving the day-to-day ownership of client programs, collaborating closely with our COE (Centre of Excellence) and Agency Operations teams to ensure timely and budget-conscious delivery across diverse client scopes.

 This position combines strategic vision with hands-on leadership, guiding a team of Account Supervisor(s) and owning the seamless execution of client programs. The Account Director serves as the end-to-end scope owner, ensuring the flawless delivery of impactful results that exceed expectations.

 Your passion for culturally relevant social and influencer strategies, coupled with your expertise in both paid and earned engagement, empowers you to own client programming from inception to completion. This entails orchestrating every facet of executional success, from meticulous tactical planning and budget management to comprehensive influencer oversight and delegation where needed to the supporting Agency Operations team.

 You excel in cross-functional project management alongside our COE teams, leveraging your analytical prowess to measure success in partnership with our BI & Measurement team. As an Account Director, you are adept at navigating post-procurement influencer facilitation and adeptly handling challenging client conversations. Your deep understanding of influencers across segments and channels, coupled with your adherence to global marketplace disclosure guidelines, ensures the efficacy of influencer-led and social-first initiatives.

 Client-facing and confident, you demonstrate expertise and assurance in all client interactions. Your superior social and interpersonal skills enable you to work autonomously while adeptly navigating collaborative dynamics and effectively 'managing up' when necessary.

 What You'll Do Here: 

 Accountable for owning and leading flawless execution of client scope(s) and working alongside their Client Service leader (VP Client Services, and/or Director, Client Services) to identify primed areas strategic business growth.

 Accountable for on-time, on-budget delivery of client scopes, prioritizing exceptional client service and five-star experiences.

 Lead the development and implementation of overarching strategic direction for a diverse portfolio of social and influencer campaigns, from individual activations to long-term, relationship-focused initiatives, ensuring alignment with client objectives and the agency's overarching vision.

 Know the components needed for flawless executional delivery, and push for exceptionally creative and unique work across a mix of global clientele in collaboration with our COE team(s). 

 Spearhead various key responsibilities, including influencer engagement, paid social, and measurement. Additionally, you will drive creative ideation, manage briefs, cultivate and nurture client relationships, present concepts effectively, develop compelling presentations, and offer clear perspectives on trends that significantly impact our strategies. 

 Take ownership of post-procurement influencer management, transitioning seamlessly from talent acquisition to nurturing enduring partnerships and facilitating content creation that authentically represents brand narratives and resonates with target audiences.

 Manage team development and growth to meet the demands and expectations of clients for Account Supervisor(S). Support in feedback loop for career development of our Agency Operations Team. 

 Oversee your teams influencer marketing campaigns through VN’s proprietary platform(s)

 Foster seamless collaboration and synergy with Center of Excellence (COE) teams, orchestrating cross-functional cooperation to ensure flawless execution of client scopes, adhering to timelines and deliverables.

 Lead by example, fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment where team members are empowered to contribute their unique perspectives and ideas, driving creativity, innovation, and professional growth.

 You'll Need to Have: 

 6+ years of digital/social/marketing experience

 Expert knowledge of paid and organic influencer tactics

 Experience managing multiple client portfolios across various and integrated service offerings 

 Strong understanding of influencer marketing and expert grasp of social media platforms

 Proficient in interpreting and applying where necessary information provided by influencer management software (such as Creator IQ, Klear, Tagger, Upfluence)

 Excelling project management skills with a keen eye for detail

 Works collaboratively with planning and creative teams to drive business outcomes

 Good understanding of paid and social amplification

 Proficient with MS Office, Google or other presentation software

 Robust experience with cross-channel integration

 Certification in Facebook Blueprint, Twitter Flight School and/or Google Analytics

 Social media tools like Sprout, Sprinklr, Hootsuite

 CRM software experience like Hubspot

  

 This role has an annual salary range of $100,000 to $140,000. 

  

 This range reflects the full scope and progression of the role, from building capability to operating with sustained impact at a higher level. In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits and total rewards package designed to support our team as they grow with us.

Where an offer falls within this range is determined through the interview process. Candidates are benchmarked by the hiring team based on role scope, relevant experience, skill alignment, and expected impact, using consistent and objective criteria.

 Compensation Philosophy: 

At Viral Nation, compensation is structured, performance-led, and market-aligned. Pay decisions are intentional, based on role requirements, performance, and market alignment by country, and are set to maintain internal pay equity across comparable roles and levels.

Compensation progression is tied to demonstrated performance, expanded scope, and sustained contribution over time, not tenure alone. Employee compensation is reviewed regularly through formal performance reviews and check-ins to ensure alignment with role expectations and impact.

  

 AI in Recruitment: 

  

 Viral Nation does not use AI-enabled tools to screen, assess, rank, or select candidates – our hiring teams make all hiring decisions. AI note-taking tools may be used during interviews.

 DEI Commitment: 

 Viral Nation is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our agency. Viral Nation welcomes applications from people with visible and non-visible disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruiting and selection process.

jobs.description:

 Position Overview: 

 Viral Nation is one of the most advanced applied-AI companies in North America, and the Director, Content Marketing is expected to operate like it. Reporting to the VP, Demand Generation, the Director builds and runs an AI-accelerated content engine that turns Viral Nation’s expertise, proprietary social data, and multi-vertical story into MQLs, SQLs, and pipeline sourced and influenced. The audience is clear: the content exists to attract and convert enterprise brands and the decision makers and marketing leaders who choose their agency partners. This role owns content strategy and execution end-to-end, from editorial vision to distribution, brand governance, and performance reporting, with a mandate to convert content into measurable pipeline across B2B and B2C audiences. Leading a lean team of two content contributors plus partnering with SEO/GEO and Owned Social leads, the Director is a player-coach, shipping high-impact thought leadership from the first weeks while building the systems that let the function scale.

 Use AI to accelerate content marketing

 Design and own an AI-enabled content production system (e.g., Claude, Claude Code, custom agents and workflows) that sustains a high-volume, always-on cadence without sacrificing quality or brand voice.

 Build reusable prompts, voice guides, templates, and agentic workflows so research, drafting, repurposing, and QA run as a repeatable engine rather than one-off efforts.

 Partner with Viral Nation’s applied-AI teams and tooling to produce work that is better, faster, and more differentiated than a traditional content function could deliver.

 Set the standard for responsible AI use in content: human editorial judgment, fact-checking, and brand governance on every asset.

 Operationalize the content function to drive business growth 

 Translate business objectives into a cohesive content strategy and editorial calendar aimed at winning enterprise brand clients, tied to demand-generation and pipeline goals across the full funnel.

 Run the function as an operating system: clear roles, workflows, checks and balances, and deadlines managed in Monday.com, with weekly cadence reviews and visible status for every asset.

 Design content-to-conversion pathways, gated assets, nurture tracks, landing pages, and CTAs that capture, qualify, and advance leads in partnership with the demand-gen team.

 Build the tracking and attribution framework (UTMs, conversion events, multi-touch attribution) with marketing ops/RevOps so content-sourced and content-influenced pipeline is visible in HubSpot.

 Define, instrument, and own the content KPIs that matter to lead gen: traffic-to-lead conversion, MQL/SQL volume, pipeline influenced and sourced, cost-per-lead, engagement-to-conversion, and content-assisted revenue and ROI.

 Run a continuous test-and-optimize cycle (headlines, formats, CTAs, offers) and reallocate effort toward what generates the most qualified demand.

 Deliver actionable performance reporting and executive-level insights to senior leadership to guide investment and prioritization.

 Produce and ship content through a hyper-growth phase 

 Personally write, edit, and ship high-impact thought leadership, while standing up the system that lets the team sustain it.

 Establish a weekly cadence of differentiated thought leadership that makes the gap between Viral Nation and the next competitor unmistakable, alongside tentpole white papers and research reports.

 Turn Viral Nation’s proprietary social and creator data into a steady stream of data-driven listicles, rankings, and insight pieces.

 Capitalize on cultural and industry moments in real time, weighing in with a point of view on what is happening in influencer and social marketing as it happens.

 Drive quick wins early: repurpose and redistribute high-performing assets, refresh high-potential content, and improve CTAs while longer-form programs come online.

 Expand beyond written formats into video and visual assets in partnership with the in-house creative team, including client case-study and testimonial video that shows what it is like to work with Viral Nation.

 Distribution, brand, and team 

 Drive distribution of content through the channels this role owns (web, blog, SEO, email, gated assets) in partnership with demand gen, and the Manager, Owned Social with content and source material so thought leadership shows up consistently on LinkedIn and other platforms.

 Oversee SEO-optimized content built to rank and convert, working with the in-house SEO experts and performance data to grow qualified organic traffic.

 Partner with cross-functional leaders across SEO, product, sales, and demand gen to align content with launches and the buyer journey, fuel campaigns, and enable sales.

 Enforce editorial standards and keep messaging consistent with brand guidelines across every touchpoint.

 Manage and mentor the two content contributors plus a scalable freelance/agency bench into a high-performing team; set clear priorities for what the Director owns versus what the team executes.

 Lead competitive and industry research, and stay ahead of platform shifts, AI-driven workflows, and emerging audience behaviors.

 Qualifications and Skills: 

 Hands-on, current fluency with AI content tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) and experience building AI-assisted or agentic workflows (e.g., Claude Code, custom agents) that scale production while protecting brand voice and quality.

 8+ years in content marketing, digital marketing, or communications, including experience owning content as a lead-generation channel and leading a team; agency, B2B/B2C, or high-growth environment preferred.

 Demonstrated track record of using content to drive measurable pipeline: traffic-to-lead conversion, MQL/SQL growth, and content-influenced revenue and ROI.

 Proven ability to operationalize a content function: build workflows, cadences, and accountability in a project management platform (e.g., Monday.com, Asana) and run a lean team against aggressive output goals.

 Strong writer and editor who can personally produce executive-grade thought leadership, and who is comfortable being a player-coach during a build phase.

 Strong leadership and executive-level presentation skills, with experience building and mentoring multi-disciplinary content teams and managing freelance/agency resources.

 Data-driven, funnel-minded, and comfortable being accountable to revenue-adjacent metrics.

 This role has an annual salary range of $125,000 to $150,000. 

  

 This range reflects the full scope and progression of the role, from building capability to operating with sustained impact at a higher level. In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits and total rewards package designed to support our team as they grow with us.

Where an offer falls within this range is determined through the interview process. Candidates are benchmarked by the hiring team based on role scope, relevant experience, skill alignment, and expected impact, using consistent and objective criteria.

  

 Compensation Philosophy: 

At Viral Nation, compensation is structured, performance-led, and market-aligned. Pay decisions are intentional, based on role requirements, performance, and market alignment by country, and are set to maintain internal pay equity across comparable roles and levels.

Compensation progression is tied to demonstrated performance, expanded scope, and sustained contribution over time, not tenure alone. Employee compensation is reviewed regularly through formal performance reviews and check-ins to ensure alignment with role expectations and impact.
