new_jobs.description:
About Leo Berwick 
 Leo Berwick is an innovative, commercially focused mergers and acquisitions advisory firm serving the world’s largest infrastructure funds, infrastructure and energy developers, pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, private equity firms and their portfolio companies, publicly listed corporations, and private strategic investors across a broad range of industries, with deep expertise in infrastructure and energy. Our team of more than 120 M&A advisory leaders and specialists from the Big Four and Big Law partners with clients throughout the deal life cycle to maximize value, minimize risk, and achieve superior outcomes through tailored, high-impact advice. 
 At Leo Berwick, we hire the best and the brightest. As a growth-stage company, we move quickly, work collaboratively, and value people who take initiative and thrive in a fast-paced environment. Our culture is grounded in high performance, continuous learning, and the shared ambition to build something exceptional together while delivering dedicated, customized service to every client. What we’re looking for 
 Leo Berwick is looking for a Director to help drive the continued growth of our Energy, Infrastructure and Renewables Financial Due Diligence practice. You’ll work at the heart of complex, high-value transactions, partnering with leading corporate and financial investors to uncover key deal insights, challenge assumptions, and turn financial data into clear, actionable advice. Working across both buy-side and sell-side engagements, you’ll play a key role in helping clients navigate risk, identify value opportunities, and make confident investment decisions. 
 You’re the right fit for this role if – 
 You are a passionate financial strategist looking to be a true partner in a fast-paced, evolving firm. 
 You are a skilled communicator, able to translate complex financial data into actionable information for our leaders and clients. 
 You have experience designing and implementing policies, procedures and programs that support high performing teams aligned to our current and future growth plans. 
 You are an experienced leader able to oversee and partner across departments and teams. 
 What you'll do 
 Lead, mentor, and develop junior team members across all stages of the deal process. 
 Manage financial due diligence engagements for acquisitions and divestitures. 
 Deliver high-quality client outputs, including diligence reports and presentations, and communicate key deal implications. 
 Oversee full project lifecycle, ensuring timely and exceptional client deliverables. 
 Analyze business plans, public information, and historical financials of target companies. 
 Identify and report key risks and issues to clients. 
 Align due diligence findings with client valuations and help manage stakeholder expectations. 
 What you bring 
 5+ years of Financial Due Diligence experience, ideally including 2–3 years at the Senior Manager level within a Big Four firm. 
 Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or a related field; CPA, CFA, or comparable designation preferred. 
 Strong FDD and financial analysis expertise; Energy, Infrastructure, or Renewables experience is an asset. 
 Proven leadership and project management skills, with experience leading teams and complex engagements. 
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with sound judgment, attention to detail, and a high level of professionalism. 
 Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment, with occasional travel within Canada and the U.S. 
 Benefits & Perks 
 Unlimited paid time off including 2 weeks of disconnected time each year 
 Flexible working arrangements – remote and location flexibility 
 Tuition reimbursement 
 Attractive medical, dental insurance 
 Pension & retirement contributions 
 Monthly fringe benefit stipend (up to $400) 
 Additional benefits to support your physical and mental wellness 
 Compensation 
 This is a permanent full-time role offering a base salary range of $190,000–$210,000 CAD, commensurate with skills, experience, and alignment with the requirements of the role. Placement within this range will be determined based on experience relevant to this role and scope of responsibility.   
 Vacancy Statement 
 This posting reflects a new vacancy.  
 Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring 
 The firm uses artificial intelligence tools to screen candidates for this role. 
 Equal Opportunity Statement 
 Leo Berwick is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive and accessible workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and do not discriminate on any ground protected under applicable human rights legislation. Accommodations are available upon request at any stage of the hiring process, in accordance with applicable accessibility and human rights legislation. 
 Please contact careers@leoberwick.com to request an accommodation. Information received relating to accommodation will be kept confidential and used only to support your participation in the hiring process or as otherwise required by law.
